routes.description: Author quest appeals opt into response_version=2 with an 8–128 character idempotency_key. V2 requires access to the quest; case_id must identify the current decision. Owner or quests_publish permission is required to appeal a quest block. Legacy response remains available.
Team-only quest report details, frozen result vote percentages, viewer-personal and space financial events. Does not reveal committee members or other users’ personal finances.
